title: The Roots of Performance Disparity in Multilingual Language Models: Intrinsic Modeling Difficulty or Design Choices?

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing existing literature to analyze how modeling artifacts (such as tokenization, UTF-8 encoding inefficiencies, data sampling, and shared-parameter interference) interact with linguistic properties (orthography, morphology, syntax, and lexical diversity) to cause performance disparities across typologically diverse languages.
